note: Leads L1 — zero lead loss & intake reliability (G-01 identity poisoning, G-05 one attention queue, G-06 CloudTalk credentials, G-07 sweep health). The DB halves run in .m6 / .m5 / .m7bc batteries (m6-acquisition-ci, m5-crm-lifecycle-ci, m7a-foundation-ci).

lib/intake/identity/contact-assurance.te.reason: G-01 identity-policy@2: a website form's self-asserted email never resolves through an existing email link (owner proposal instead), never creates identity links, a self-asserted phone + another customer's linked email is a conflict, and every read stays inside its business (cross-tenant identity poisoning refused)

lib/intake/calls/cloudtalk-credentials.t.reason: G-06: a missing / refused CloudTalk API key is visible on the connection (never status ERROR, which would 401 new calls), deferral is bounded then dead-letters so the caller's number leaves with the failed-payload retention, transient errors never raise the notice, and the notice carries no number or key

lib/services/crm/lead-attention-queue.te.reason: G-05 lead-loss integrity: one attention queue ordered by urgency before any cap (a customer who called / wrote is never cut by routine follow-ups), every evaluator reason included, and Home, the needsAction list, the ranking, the count and the API all read it

lib/intake/sweep-health.test.ts.reason: G-07 silent-loss detection: the sweep verdict separates job from event failures, new dead letters (webhook-time included) and store reconciliation failures make the run unhealthy exactly once, and the report / logs carry counts only (no payload, phone, email or event id)

lib/services/crm/lead-contact-phone.test.reason: G-01b claimedPhone: the contact-phone contract carries a source, never a verification claim; no identity / routing-match / customer path reads the claimed phone; the owner API cannot write it; it is erased with the account (manifest, store, disposition) and exported in its own non-importable column
